consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: unrelieved potential energy found after isolation of PSV-8210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-8210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. PSV-8210 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 23 January 2024 a high potential incident was recorded on PSV-8210 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during transfer operations; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
